clue.text: What a roofer did when agitated?

definitions.meaning: a roofer laboured up on top of the house
flustered and het up, in an excited state

explanation.surface: A question about what a roofer did once he got upset.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofer laboured high on the building, while someone flustered and excited is in the same idiomatic state.

clue.text: The ass wants orange squash

indicators.note: to squash something is to crush it out of shape, so these letters are pressed into a new order

explanation.surface: A donkey would like a glass of orange squash, the British fruit cordial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squash' looks like the drink (a British fruit cordial) but it signals the anagram of ORANGE.
explanation.definitionFit: The onager is a wild ass of Asia, a species of the donkey family.

clue.text: Reportedly calmer on learning one's fate

indicators.note: reportedly means as people say it, so the word is heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: calmer means more tranquil, said here in a non-rhotic British accent

explanation.surface: Someone grows more serene on discovering their destiny.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent the R of 'calmer' is silent, so it sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: In Hindu and Buddhist belief, karma is the destiny earned by one's deeds.

clue.text: His spirits make a woman more sedate

parts.note: Di is a short woman's name, as in Diana
more sedate means quieter or more still

explanation.surface: His liquor would make a woman calmer.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as 'his spirits make' — a man who makes spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: A distillery worker produces whisky, gin and other strong drink.

clue.text: A pole in the money makes reparation

indicators.note: in means these letters sit inside the money word

parts.note: pence are British coins, money
N stands for the North Pole

explanation.surface: Someone pays a Polish person to make amends.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is a self-imposed punishment done to atone for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Moralise before going to a church

parts.note: pre is a prefix meaning before

explanation.surface: Someone lectures on morals before heading off to church.
explanation.definitionFit: To sermonise or lecture others on right and wrong.

clue.text: Bread for a sober man in Panama

indicators.note: in means these letters sit inside the Panama abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the international code for Panama
a means one, the Roman numeral I
TT stands for teetotal, a sober person who drinks no alcohol

explanation.surface: Food for a teetotaller living in Panama.
explanation.definitionFit: Pitta is a flat, hollow Middle Eastern loaf.

clue.text: No longer a single charge. Is that clear?

parts.note: ex means former, no longer
a single is one
a rate is a charge or fee

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether dropping a charge means they have been acquitted.
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate is to free from blame, absolving someone of guilt.

clue.text: Many a dog-trainer wants his goods

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, i.e. many
a handler trains and works with dogs

explanation.surface: Many a dog trainer wants his belongings.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the trader whose goods these are: a dealer in candles or ship's supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A dealer selling candles or ship's stores is named for the merchandise he sells.

clue.text: Crazy artists demand capital

parts.note: crazy means mad
RAs are Royal Academicians, i.e. artists

explanation.surface: Wild artists make demands about money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money; it is the former name of Chennai, capital of Tamil Nadu.
explanation.definitionFit: Madras was the old name of Chennai, a state capital in India.

clue.text: Leading steeplechase of the country

definitions.meaning: the Grand ... is Britain's foremost steeplechase horse race

explanation.surface: A top horse race that belongs to the whole nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's famous Aintree steeplechase is the Grand National; nationwide matters are also so called.

clue.text: Its telling affords Rex delight

parts.note: R stands for Rex, Latin for king
elation is great delight

explanation.surface: Telling something gives the king pleasure.
explanation.walkthrough: Here the answer means a narrative or account, the act of telling a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrative account is the act of recounting a story.

clue.text: A Frenchman aims to offer compensation

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a Frenchman
ends are aims or goals

explanation.surface: A Frenchman intends to pay damages.
explanation.definitionFit: To make amends is to give recompense for a wrong.

clue.text: They transport fish in fine cars

indicators.note: in means the fish sits inside the fine cars

parts.note: Rollers is slang for Rolls-Royces, fine cars
a skate is a flat fish

explanation.surface: Fish are carried in luxury cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Wheeled boots carry their wearers along.

clue.text: Getting better at changing position

definitions.meaning: ... means forming again in a new arrangement, as troops do

explanation.surface: Improving at shifting position.
explanation.definitionFit: Improving one's conduct; and, split as re-forming, regrouping troops into a new line.

clue.text: Account in the new testament

indicators.note: new means the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A passage in the New Testament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' looks like part of 'New Testament' but signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement is a written or spoken report.

clue.text: Estate he refurbished, being a man of taste

indicators.note: refurbished means done up again, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A refurbished estate shows the owner's refinement.
explanation.definitionFit: An aesthete is someone with a refined appreciation of beauty and art.

clue.text: We let far east develop social services

indicators.note: develop means grow into something new, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: We should allow the Far East to build its welfare system.
explanation.definitionFit: A welfare system is the government provision of social security and health care.

clue.text: Begin by getting champion ram

parts.note: a star is a champion performer
tup is a word for a ram

explanation.surface: Start by acquiring a champion ram for the flock.
explanation.definitionFit: To start up is to begin or set going.

clue.text: Couple confronting a lad in the slammer

parts.note: PR is the abbreviation for pair, a couple
a means one, the Roman numeral I
a son is a lad

explanation.surface: A couple face a young man in jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Slammer is slang for jail.

clue.text: Looks hard to find small weeds

parts.note: tares are weeds, as in the Bible parable

explanation.surface: Someone peers to locate small weeds.
explanation.definitionFit: To gaze fixedly is to look intently.

clue.text: Riddle is upsetting Adam's wife

indicators.note: in a down clue upsetting turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: Eve was the wife of Adam in Genesis

explanation.surface: A puzzle is troubling Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a coarse sieve, and to riddle is to sift.

clue.text: Opening for a jaunty banker

parts.note: pert means jaunty or lively
a banker is a river (it has banks); the Ure is a Yorkshire river

explanation.surface: A job vacancy for a cheerful bank employee.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperture is a gap or hole.

clue.text: Lag behind on the track

definitions.meaning: to fall behind or drag after

explanation.surface: Falling behind on the race track.
explanation.definitionFit: To straggle is to trail; a path through country is also a trail.

clue.text: Local team beset by division

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded, so one word is enclosed by the other

parts.note: a rent is a split or division
a side is a team

explanation.surface: A local team troubled by a split.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' looks like an adjective but here it is a noun, someone who lives in the area.
explanation.definitionFit: A local is someone living in the area, an inhabitant.

clue.text: Go by in order, please

indicators.note: putting the letters in order means arranging them properly, a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A polite request to pass by in turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Time passing is said to slip away.

clue.text: Black bird caught by a dog

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as in pencil grading
an eagle is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A black bird is caught by a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The beagle is a small hound breed.

clue.text: Could it be cannabis?

parts.note: cannabis is grown in a container as a houseplant; 'pot' is also slang for the drug itself

explanation.definitionFit: A houseplant in a container; cannabis grown indoors fits, and pot is slang for the drug.
